fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied no street address (Indeed locations list) and city-centroid coords (36.2081, -86.2911) in downtown Lebanon, ~9km off. Resolved to 14840 Central Pike / 14840 Duke Dr, Lebanon TN 37090 - the documented DSC Logistics Lebanon facility (B&G Foods distribution). DSC Logistics is the legacy company CJ Logistics America was formed from, so this is the CJ Logistics Lebanon site. Geocoded ROOFTOP to ~36.130, -86.406; satellite confirmed a large cross-dock DC in the Lebanon / I-840 logistics corridor.
fieldNotes.truckGate: z20-z21 satellite clearly shows a gate (cantilever / swing gate) spanning the truck lane at the SW end of the truck court, with perimeter fencing along the court. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small booth structure sits immediately beside the SW gate - a guard shack controlling truck entry.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long cross-dock building (~700ft) with trailers backed into dock doors along both long faces (SW and SE/NE). Estimated ~70 total doors (50+ band). Approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Row of ~25-30 parked trailers in the SE/NE truck court drop area, separate from active docks. dropArea 25-50, dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on opposing building faces (SW and NE/SE) form physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate set well back from the public road with a long internal approach and a deep truck court that wraps the building -> holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: One confirmed gate at the SW truck court entry; a second NE access point may exist but no gate confirmed there. Counted as 1.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: 14840 Central Pike sits in the Lebanon / Mount Juliet I-840 logistics corridor (Park 840 Logistics Center cluster) within greater Nashville metro, surrounded by multiple large DCs -> Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~35 acres from the perimeter box (building plus wrapping truck courts).
